Ria (CS): FYI tenant 'orion-spark' goes live 08:30 PT. Need a 6-item CSM quickplay (prefill, warm pool, jitter, batching hints, streaming fallback, renewal_risk mapping). Keep copy/paste snippets.
Hector (Solutions): Ill draft 6 checkboxes + curl/js + telemetry example.
Mina (SRE): Infra checks I own: 1) GET /healthz?tenant=orion-spark -> 200; 2) run 3 prefill probes; 3) enable warm pool 30m; jitter policy: base=90ms + rand(0..150ms), max_retries=3.
Ria (CS): Add line: "Limit prefill per-user to 600 tokens" and label samples staging/prod.
Hector (Solutions): Prefill curl (pasteable):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"orion-spark","samples":["Hi, show my usage","Open my invoice"]}'
```
Hector (Solutions): Tiny JS snippet:```js
fetch('/v1/prefill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer K'},body:JSON.stringify({tenant:'orion-spark',samples:['hi']})})
```
Liam (PM): renewal_risk rule (one-liner): high if any -> 7d P95 latency >450ms OR 1h error rate >2% OR >=1 negative survey in 48h. medium if one marginal breach. low otherwise. cs-bot DM on high.
Mina (SRE): Streaming fallback: if stream aborts within 5s, retry sync generate with max_tokens=220 and header `X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync`. Log `fallback=stream_sync`.
Hector (Solutions): Batching hint: interactive UI target batch=3-6; background jobs 20-48. If tail latency increases, flip to emergency small-batch (batch=2 + kv_cache=true).
Hector (Solutions): Telemetry sample: {"event":"prefill","tenant":"orion-spark","account_risk":"low","tokens":48,"latency_ms":130,"survey_sent":false}
Ria (CS): Perfect. I'll make a one-pager with 6 checkboxes and paste into kickoff mail.
cs-bot: Alert rule created -> will DM @Ria when renewal_risk==high.
